author: Krono I
title: Implicit Planning v3 (Deep CNN + Lookahead)
abstract: This experiment builds on the working prototype (ID 85). It re-integrates the deep residual CNN from the high-performing baseline, replacing the prototype's simple encoder. The LSTM remains omitted to isolate the interaction between a powerful state representation and the one-step lookahead mechanism. The hypothesis is that a better spatial encoder will significantly improve the performance of the planning module, leading to a score substantially higher than the prototype's 0.9.
